paragraphs: In this parasha I did not write halachot for the second year, because every year [the rabbi] expounds the laws of Chanukah in this parasha instead.

clarification.explanation: No halachot were written for parashat Vayeshev in the second year, because every year Rabbi Yosef Chaim expounds the laws of Chanukah in this parasha (which falls near Chanukah) instead.
takeaways: Parashat Vayeshev (second year) is devoted every year to the laws of Chanukah instead of the regular series of halachot.
